public_synthetic_budget_probe.mechanism: Source IDs become short aliases; inline citation_ref attributes are added; len(annotated memory) must be <= context_chars. Canonical catalog and original fields stay private; schema contains ref enum values only. Question, instructions and schema are additional metadata, not source-content budget.

verified_properties.reader_boundary: Each Capture request receives one context and its own catalog; question_id is part of cache scope; exact serialized request bytes are compared before reuse.
verified_properties.judge_boundary: Case-specific reader_visible_memory, source catalogs and mechanical citation bounds use the corresponding question view; original history is reference truth only.
verified_properties.durability: Capture saves raw response and actual ledger receipt before response validation; each successful question part is saved before next dispatch. Partial failure records completed parts and disallows automatic retry/resume.
verified_properties.denominator: Planned denominator remains six questions per history; absent judge batches lower completeness instead of shrinking denominator. Partial parts are reported ungraded and count as failures.
verified_properties.usage: Ledger counts actual native calls once. Combined reader metrics sum six per-question metrics; equivalent reuse allocations remain separate from actual usage.
verified_properties.attribution: Isolation mode uses per-question memory equality strata and own-view explanatory wording.
verified_properties.export_logical_attempts: Public complete export has 2 graded attempts per question for 2 arms x 1 repeat, and 4 for 2 arms x 2 repeats; durable part artifacts remain available without duplicated logical attempts.
verified_properties.partial_regeneration: Public synthetic regeneration-1 reader-1 partial reports run_id regeneration-1, repeat 1, planned denominator 6, graded 0 and actual ledger calls 0.

limitations: Static code review and public mocked tests do not establish live model compliance or performance on sealed R8 inputs.
